The video is a high-quality cinematic commercial captured in bright, natural daylight with a clean, modern aesthetic and a 16:9 aspect ratio.
[Shot 1] The shot begins as a medium shot using <Picture 1> as the starting frame featuring <Subject 1> walking confidently toward the camera on a city street. <Subject 1> is wearing a black ribbed turtleneck, grey tailored trousers, and black loafers strictly aligned with the styling reference in <Picture 2>. In her right hand, she holds <Subject 2>, a sleek black tube with the text "CORAL_LIPSTICK" visible near the base. The camera performs a smooth pull-out with medium amplitude at a slow speed, widening the frame to reveal the vibrant context of <Subject 3>. As the frame expands, <Subject 1> executes a smooth pivot, turning her body to face the lens directly. She lifts <Subject 2> to chest level, presenting the product with a confident, bright grin. <Subject 1> (S1) delivers a confident, bright line of dialogue. She continues her forward trajectory, passing by a cluster of office workers on a crosswalk. The shot concludes as <Subject 1> moves deeper into the background, becoming integrated into the bustling urban crowd. The visual focus shifts to the dynamic depth of <Subject 3> as the camera remains stationary in its final pull-out position.
